notes.title: Tighter Movement? :O (Patch 0.0.5)
notes.content:
It might be more fun to be able to squeeze between enemies. More close calls = more fun! So I tightened up the movement. Let me know what you think. 

This patch also contains some other small changes:

- Tighter controls
- Stronger pushback when dash finishes
- Better menu navigation
- Indication for when Zebra is ending
- Mouse cursor hides properly when using controller
- Added small shop tutorial for first time shop
